My sister got me one of those smart speakers for my birthday, the kind you can talk to and ask questions whenever you want.
I set it up in my living room, and for the first few days, everything seemed totally fine.
I asked it about the weather, played some music, normal everyday stuff.
Then things got weird.
One night, I was watching a show, and in the middle of it, someone on screen said a word that sounded kind of like the speaker's wake word.
Out of nowhere, the speaker lit up and said, "Sorry, I didn't catch that," completely interrupting the scene.
I laughed it off the first time.
But it kept happening, over and over, every single time that word came up in the show.
By the end of the episode, the thing had interrupted me probably ten times, and I was starting to get a little annoyed with it.
The real trouble started a few nights later.
I was talking to my roommate about grocery shopping, just casually mentioning we were low on paper towels.
The next morning, I got a notification that a huge box of paper towels had been ordered and was already on its way to my door.

Apparently, at some point during our conversation, I must have said something close enough to the wake word, and the speaker heard "order paper towels" and just went ahead and did it, no questions asked.
I didn't even know it could do that without asking me to confirm first.
Now I have enough paper towels to last me probably two years, stacked up in the hallway closet because there's honestly nowhere else to put them.
My roommate thought it was hilarious and started testing what other random words would set it off, just to mess with me.
We spent an entire evening going through random phrases, writing down which ones accidentally triggered it and which ones didn't do anything at all.
By the end of the evening, we had a whole list taped to the fridge, half joke and half genuine warning for future guests.
Eventually, I looked up the settings and turned off the voice ordering feature completely.
Honestly, it should've been off from the start.
Now the speaker just plays music and tells me the weather, which is really all I wanted from it in the first place anyway.
My sister still asks if I've ordered anything weird lately, and every single time, I tell her about the paper towels.
She thinks it's the best gift she's ever given anyone, and she brings it up at almost every family dinner now, usually right before dessert.
I'm still not totally sure she's wrong about that.
